superseded_reason: Four overlapping V2 trailing windows can be produced by one outlier, so the candidate count was not evidence of independent repeated dispersion. It must not be used for V3 execution or evaluation. The non-overlapping-block replacement is V3_NONOVERLAPPING_PROSPECTIVE_PROTOCOL.json.
purpose: Prospective isolated-software feasibility test of a causal, bounded packet-arrival observation. It is not an attack, health, receiver-outage, or recovery detector.
semantics: A result occurs only when four V2 candidate trailing-dispersion observations for one exact context arrive within the preceding one second. The deque expires on a later valid packet in that same context; normal valid observations do not add candidates; invalid/unknown observations never count or default to healthy.
parameter_status: The count and one-second bound are provisional engineering parameters chosen to require repeated temporally bounded evidence, not fitted performance thresholds. V2 and earlier runs are excluded from V3 performance estimation and must not be used to claim this rule passes.

required: Every capture passes structural validation and frozen inputs match before replay.
Report every run, unknown/invalid count, and first observation time.
Do not revise the frozen rule from V3 results before an independent review.
run_level_acceptance_for_feasibility_onl.interpretation: No operating-performance or recovery criterion is claimed before fresh data. Controls are reported as controls, not tuned against.

prohibitions: No future/EOF packet, filename, scenario label, or supplied outcome label is a feature.
No recovery action, physical timing, GNSS, SyncE, oscillator, attack, or receiver-outage claim follows from this observation.
